reviews.title: AS3 flash.net.navigateToURL browser navigation and POST form dispatch
reviews.summary: Promotes flash.net.navigateToURL(request, window) from partial to working: validates safe HTTP(S), relative and mailto: URLs, blocks javascript:/data:/vbscript:/file: schemes, supports _self/_blank/_parent/_top and named window targets, and submits POST requests via hidden form or query parameters.
